column1: # Drug class terms of each database -> one shared class, used only to compare phenotypes of matched mutations.
# Classes are coarse on purpose: beta-lactam subclasses are one class; polymyxins and lipopeptides are 'peptide' because
# CARD's 'peptide antibiotic' covers both; sulfonamides, trimethoprim and para-aminosalicylic acid are 'folate pathway'.
# Empty class = the term names no drug class (MULTIDRUG, EFFLUX, Unspecified). The build fails on a term not listed.
